button.label: Changes
button.title: What you changed and what is not sent yet

title: Changes

state.cloningLead: Your changes will appear when it is ready.
state.connectTitle: Could not connect to the repository
state.connectLead: Check the address and access in the list of spaces.

intro: Only you can see these edits for now. To reach students, they have to be sent for review.

empty.title: No changes yet
empty.draft: Open a document and press “Change conditions” or “Document text”. Everything you edit will be collected here.
empty.released: Version {{version}} is released and cannot change. Make a copy with “Edit a copy” and edit the copy.

folder.title: Your edits are already written to the folder.
folder.lead: This space has no sending: save and send changes the way you usually work with this folder. Connect a repository to send from here.

checks.title: Checks
checks.warnings_one: {{count}} formatting remark. It does not block sending.
checks.warnings_few: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.warnings_many: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.warnings_other: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.notes: Describe what changed for students and supervisors: the version cannot be released without it. This is a normal step, not an error.

request.openLead: Now it is up to the repository maintainers: they will review the changes and accept them into the main branch.
request.awaiting: Waiting for approval: GitHub does not run checks for a new contributor until a maintainer allows it
request.unknown: Check status is unknown: the hosting does not report it
request.nextClean: You can keep editing: new changes will go into the same request.
request.nextEdits: There are edits that are not in the request yet. When you send them, they go into the same request.
request.mergedLead: The changes are in the main branch, students get them with the next Studio release.
request.mergedNext: Your branch is not needed anymore: a new edit starts from the fresh main branch.
request.closedLead: The changes did not reach the main branch. You can reset your changes and start clean.

where.branch: Working branch (the line of your changes): {{branch}}.
where.ahead: Saved points ahead of the main branch: {{count}}.
where.noBranch: The edits are only yours for now: nothing has been sent to the repository.

behind.title: The main branch has news.
behind.lead: Take them so that the request does not conflict.
behind.done: News from the main branch taken
behind.upToDate: Nothing new in the main branch

menu.label: More about changes
menu.take: Take news from the main branch

next.folderTitle: Edits are written straight to the folder on disk. There is nothing to send from here: git is not set up in this folder.

hint.checkAccess: Could not connect to the repository. We will check the address and access.
hint.makeCopy: This version is released and does not change. We will make a copy for your edits and pick its number ourselves.
hint.toDraft: Your edits are in another version. We will open it.
hint.fixErrors: The check found errors. You cannot send until they are fixed. We will show what to fix.
hint.describe: Write a couple of sentences about what changed. It is needed to release the version.
hint.submit: All set. We will open the Changes panel, it has a single send button.
hint.request: Your edits are under review. We will open the Changes panel with the details.
hint.updateRequest: You kept editing after sending. We will add the new edits to the same request.
hint.startNew: The request was accepted. We will start a new edit from the fresh main branch.

notes.title: What changed for students and supervisors
notes.lead: A few short phrases about what changed in this version, one item per line. They go into the version's change list. Without them the version cannot be released.
notes.breakingRu: What will stop working as before (in Russian)
notes.breakingEn: What will stop working as before (in English)
notes.classNoteHint: The number is lower than the Studio suggests for your edits. Explain why that is fine.
notes.pairs: There must be the same number of items in Russian and in English: as many lines in one field as in the other.
notes.suggestHint: We will fill in a draft from what you edited. You can rewrite it.
notes.needed: Fill in both fields: the version cannot be released without notes.

classHint.small: Fixes: texts, files, signature places. Projects get the update as a card.
classHint.features: New without breaking anything: fields, documents, deadlines.
classHint.regulation: New edition of the regulation: another intake year.

release.label: Release version {{version}}
release.lead: A released version is closed for edits: once the request is accepted, students use it and new edits go into its copy.
release.numberBad: These edits need a number of at least {{version}}. Change the number, otherwise the version cannot be released.
release.outdated: The version is already released in your branch, but you edited it afterwards. We will release it again.
release.setDefault: Make it the default version for new projects

number.title: Version number
number.lead: The version is {{version}} now. Pick how big these changes are: the number depends on it.
number.majorHint: For a new edition of the regulation enter the intake year, for example 2027.1.0.
number.unrelease: The version is already released in your branch. After the number changes it must be released again, we will do it when sending.

where.new: We will send your edits for review: repository maintainers will check them and accept them into the main branch {{base}}. For that a merge request opens, that is, a request to accept your edits. You do not need to create a branch: it is created automatically.
where.update: New edits will be added to the already open request {{label}}. Nothing needs to be created again.
where.service: Sending goes on behalf of the Studio installation, your name will be on the edits.
where.viaFork: Edits go through your copy of the repository (a fork): {{url}}.

request.title: Request title
request.titleHint: If left empty, the Studio makes up a title from the changed versions.
request.descriptionHint: Say why these edits are needed. The Studio adds the “what changes for students” summary itself.

license.consent: I agree that my contribution is public and distributed under the repository license ({{license}})
license.hint: The request goes from your hosting account and everyone can see it. Consent is asked once for this space.
license.afterMerge: Official templates ship with the Studio: once the request is accepted, the new version reaches users with the next release.

ack.label: I know the result of ready-made cases will change
ack.hint: This does not forbid sending, but confirmation is needed while such cases exist.

submit.impactWaiting: Working out what changes for students: sending turns on when it finishes.

fork.title: You cannot write to this repository
fork.lead: We will send your edits to your own copy of the repository (called a fork) and open the request from there. This is what you do without rights to the repository itself.
fork.createHint: The Studio creates a copy on GitHub from your account and sends the edits there.
fork.ownHint: A copy on the same server as the repository.
fork.urlHint: The Studio remembers it for this space.

reason.fork_host_mismatch: The copy must be on the same server as the repository: the token is tied to the server.
reason.fork_unavailable: Could not create or find a copy. Enter the address of your own.

fork.reasonOther: Could not create a copy. Enter the address of your own.

failure.resume: Everything before it is already done. Retry starts from this step.
failure.lint: The check found errors, the version was not sent. Click an error to go to the place.
failure.taken: Number {{version}} is already released in the main branch. Your edits can be moved to the free number {{suggested}}.

outcome.title: Edits were sent, but the request could not be opened.
outcome.lead: The branch with your edits is already on the hosting. You can open the request there by hand.

blocker.errors: You cannot send while checks have errors. Fix them.
blocker.notes: Describe what changed in Russian and in English: you cannot send without it.
blocker.consent: Confirm that you accept the license.
blocker.impact: Working out what changes for students. It is quick.
blocker.ack: Confirm that you know the result of ready-made cases changes.
blocker.fork: Enter the address of your copy of the repository.
blocker.moving: Moving edits to the new number…
